Core stylesheet structure containing templates, variables, keys, output settings, namespace and extension info, and links to imports/includes. Not API-stable per header note.
Per-context cache for reusable temporary result tree fragments and stack elements to reduce allocations.
Execution context for a transformation: holds stacks, current nodes, documents, XPath context, error handlers, caches, and runtime extras.

Wrapper structure for passing parameters and context to xsl:number processing. Holds literal attributes (level, count, from, value, format), formatting flags and grouping info, the current document/node, and compiled match patterns for count/from. struct _xsltFormatNumberInfo {
    int     integer_hash;       /* Number of '#' in integer part */
    int     integer_digits;     /* Number of '0' in integer part */
    int     frac_digits;        /* Number of '0' in fractional part */
    int     frac_hash;          /* Number of '#' in fractional part */
    int     group;              /* Number of chars per display 'group' */
    int     multiplier;         /* Scaling for percent or permille */
    char    add_decimal;        /* Flag for whether decimal point appears in pattern */
    char    is_multiplier_set;  /* Flag to catch multiple occurences of percent/permille */
    char    is_negative_pattern;/* Flag for processing -ve prefix/suffix */
};
objects.description: Holds parsed pattern parameters for number formatting used by xsl:number (counts of required/optional digits, grouping size, multiplier for percent/permille, and flags controlling decimal point and negative pattern handling). No constructors are declared here; populate based on parsed format patterns.
Forward-declared internal compiled match pattern type used by xsltNumberData for count/from patterns. Only a forward declaration appears in this header; definition is elsewhere.

Alias pointer type for XML character data used across libxml2; declared here as an extern constant pointer xsltExtMarker, but the type itself is not defined in this header. Included for completeness only if defined here; however, xmlChar is declared in libxml headers, not this file.

DOM node from libxml2. Only referenced here; not defined in this header.

objects.definition: typedef struct _xsltSecurityPrefs xsltSecurityPrefs;
objects.description: Opaque handle for the XSLT security preferences used to restrict file and network access during transformations. The actual struct layout is hidden (forward-declared only) and managed via the provided API. Allocate with xsltNewSecurityPrefs and free with xsltFreeSecurityPrefs. Set per-option checks using xsltSetSecurityPrefs or apply defaults via xsltSetDefaultSecurityPrefs. Can be attached to a transformation context with xsltSetCtxtSecurityPrefs.

Enumeration of configurable security options controlling permissions for file and network operations during XSLT processing. Used with xsltSetSecurityPrefs and xsltGetSecurityPrefs to associate or retrieve a check callback for each option.

Function pointer type for user-defined security checks. Receives the security preferences, the transformation context, and a string value (e.g., a file path or URL). Should return non-zero to allow and zero to forbid the operation. Callbacks are associated per xsltSecurityOption via xsltSetSecurityPrefs. Note: xsltTransformContextPtr is referenced from another header and not defined here.

functions.name: xsltNewStylesheet
functions.description: Allocate and initialize a new internal xsltStylesheet object. Intended for internal libxslt use to create an empty stylesheet handle before parsing/filling. Not part of public API/ABI.
requirements: Caller must free the returned stylesheet with xsltFreeStylesheet when no longer needed.
Thread-safety and reentrancy guarantees are unknown (internal API).

functions.name: xsltParseStylesheetFile
functions.description: Parse an XSLT stylesheet from a file path/URI (UTF-8 xmlChar string) and return an internal xsltStylesheet. Internal function; not public API/ABI.
requirements: filename must point to a null-terminated xmlChar string containing the file path/URI.
Returned pointer must be freed with xsltFreeStylesheet.
I/O, parsing options, and error reporting behavior are not specified here; caller should prepare libxml2 global initialization as needed.

functions.name: xsltFreeStylesheet
functions.description: Free an xsltStylesheet and all resources owned by it. Internal deallocator for stylesheet handles created by libxslt internals.
requirements: style must be a valid stylesheet previously created/returned by libxslt (e.g., xsltNewStylesheet/xsltParseStylesheetFile/xsltParseStylesheetDoc).
Behavior on NULL is unspecified in this header; pass a valid pointer.

functions.name: xsltIsBlank
functions.description: Test whether the given string consists only of whitespace characters (blank). Returns nonzero if blank, 0 otherwise. Internal utility.
requirements: str must be a pointer to a null-terminated xmlChar string (UTF-8).
Behavior for NULL is unspecified.

functions.name: xsltFreeStackElemList
functions.description: Free a linked list of xsltStackElem (variables/params) starting at elem. Internal deallocator.
requirements: elem must point to a valid list node (or possibly NULL; not specified) that was allocated/owned by libxslt.
Do not use elem after this call.

functions.name: xsltDecimalFormatGetByName
functions.description: Lookup a decimal-format by local name in the given stylesheet. Returns a pointer to the matching xsltDecimalFormat or NULL if not found. Internal helper.
requirements: style must be a valid stylesheet.
name must be a null-terminated xmlChar string naming the decimal-format.
Returned pointer is owned by the stylesheet; do not free it.

functions.name: xsltDecimalFormatGetByQName
functions.signature: xsltDecimalFormatPtr xsltDecimalFormatGetByQName(xsltStylesheetPtr style, const xmlChar *nsUri, const xmlChar *name)
functions.description: Lookup a decimal-format by QName (namespace URI and local name) in the given stylesheet. Returns the xsltDecimalFormat or NULL. Internal helper.
requirements: style must be a valid stylesheet.
name must be a null-terminated xmlChar local name.
nsUri may be NULL or a null-terminated xmlChar namespace URI depending on desired lookup; exact NULL handling is not specified here.
Returned pointer is owned by the stylesheet; do not free it.

functions.name: xsltParseStylesheetProcess
functions.description: Continue or perform stylesheet parsing/processing using the given xmlDoc into the provided stylesheet structure. Returns the (possibly same) stylesheet. Internal parsing step.
requirements: ret must be a valid xsltStylesheet to fill/update.
doc must be a valid xmlDocPtr representing the stylesheet document.
Ownership of doc is not transferred per this declaration; lifecycle rules are unspecified.

functions.name: xsltParseStylesheetOutput
functions.description: Parse xsl:output (and related) declarations starting at node cur and record output settings on the stylesheet. Internal parsing helper.
requirements: style must be a valid stylesheet object.
cur must be a valid xmlNodePtr positioned at an output-related node within a stylesheet document.

functions.name: xsltParseStylesheetDoc
functions.description: Parse an XSLT stylesheet from an in-memory xmlDoc and return an internal xsltStylesheet. Internal API.
requirements: doc must be a valid xmlDocPtr containing a stylesheet.
Returned stylesheet must be freed with xsltFreeStylesheet.
Ownership of doc is not specified here; caller should manage it appropriately.

functions.name: xsltParseStylesheetImportedDoc
functions.description: Parse an imported stylesheet xmlDoc within the context of an existing stylesheet 'style'. Returns a stylesheet object (often linked as import). Internal API.
requirements: doc must be a valid xmlDocPtr for the imported stylesheet.
style must be a valid stylesheet into which imports are being resolved.
Returned stylesheet must be freed as appropriate when the owning stylesheet is freed (exact ownership linkage unspecified here).

functions.name: xsltParseStylesheetUser
functions.description: Parse stylesheet constructs from xmlDoc into an existing stylesheet object provided by the caller. Returns an int status (exact semantics unspecified here). Internal API.
requirements: style must be a valid xsltStylesheet to populate.
doc must be a valid stylesheet xmlDocPtr.
Interpretation of return value is not documented here; caller must consult implementation.

functions.name: xsltLoadStylesheetPI
functions.description: Scan an XML document for an xml-stylesheet processing instruction and load the referenced stylesheet, returning an xsltStylesheet. Internal helper.
requirements: doc must be a valid xmlDocPtr to scan for PI.
Returned stylesheet must be freed with xsltFreeStylesheet.
I/O and URI resolution behavior is not specified here.

functions.name: xsltNumberFormat
functions.signature: void xsltNumberFormat(xsltTransformContextPtr ctxt, xsltNumberDataPtr data, xmlNodePtr node)
functions.description: Format a number according to xslt:number settings in data and current context, emitting or recording the formatted result as part of transformation. Internal formatting routine.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid transformation context in running state.
data must point to a valid xsltNumberData structure configured for formatting.
node should be a valid current node associated with numbering.

functions.name: xsltFormatNumberConversion
functions.signature: xmlXPathError xsltFormatNumberConversion(xsltDecimalFormatPtr self, xmlChar *format, double number, xmlChar **result)
functions.description: Convert a numeric value to a string per XSLT format-number() using the supplied decimal-format and pattern. On success, writes allocated result to *result and returns an xmlXPathError code (usually 0 for OK). Internal utility.
requirements: self must be a valid xsltDecimalFormat.
format must be a null-terminated xmlChar pattern string.
result must be a non-NULL pointer to receive an allocated xmlChar*; caller is responsible for freeing it using libxml2 deallocator (exact function not specified here).
Number is a finite double; handling of NaN/Inf depends on decimal-format fields.

functions.name: xsltParseTemplateContent
functions.description: Parse the content (sequence constructor) of a template element in the stylesheet and build internal compiled representations. Internal compiler routine.
requirements: style must be a valid stylesheet.
templ must be a valid xmlNodePtr pointing to the template element whose content is to be parsed.

functions.name: xsltAllocateExtra
functions.description: Allocate one extra slot in the stylesheet’s extras array (per-runtime storage descriptor) and return its index. Internal mechanism to reserve runtime-extra IDs.
requirements: style must be a valid stylesheet.
Interpretation of the return index and subsequent usage via XSLT_RUNTIME_EXTRA* macros are required for correctness.

functions.name: xsltAllocateExtraCtxt
functions.description: Allocate one extra slot in the transformation context’s extras array and return its index. Used with XSLT_RUNTIME_EXTRA* macros. Internal mechanism.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid transformation context.
Caller must use the returned index consistently with XSLT_RUNTIME_EXTRA_LST/FREE/ macros.

functions.name: xsltCreateRVT
functions.description: Create a new temporary Result Value Tree (Result Tree Fragment) document bound to the transformation context. Returns the xmlDoc of the RVT. Internal memory management facility.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid transformation context.
Returned xmlDocPtr is managed by the context; lifecycle depends on registration (tmp/local/persistent).

functions.name: xsltRegisterTmpRVT
functions.description: Register an RVT as a temporary (non-persistent) result tree with the transformation context. Internal API. Returns status int (semantics unspecified here).
requirements: ctxt must be valid.
RVT must be an xmlDocPtr representing an RVT, typically created by xsltCreateRVT.
The same RVT must not be registered multiple times in conflicting categories (tmp/local/persistent).

functions.name: xsltRegisterLocalRVT
functions.description: Register an RVT as local to the lifetime of the current instruction, to be freed when the instruction exits. Internal API. Returns status int.
requirements: ctxt must be valid.
RVT must be a valid RVT xmlDocPtr tied to ctxt.
Intended to be called by instruction implementations that create local RTFs.

functions.name: xsltRegisterPersistRVT
functions.description: Register an RVT as persistent for the duration of the transformation. Internal API. Returns status int.
requirements: ctxt must be valid.
RVT must be a valid RVT xmlDocPtr tied to ctxt.

functions.name: xsltExtensionInstructionResultRegister
functions.description: Register a result object produced by an extension instruction with the context so it can be finalized/cleaned later. Internal API.
requirements: ctxt must be valid.
obj must be a valid xmlXPathObjectPtr produced by an extension; ownership/cleanup will be coordinated by the context after registration.

functions.name: xsltExtensionInstructionResultFinalize
functions.description: Finalize and release any results previously registered via xsltExtensionInstructionResultRegister for the current context/instruction. Internal API.
requirements: ctxt must be valid.
Must be called after registering extension instruction results to avoid leaks; exact calling phase and return semantics are not documented here.

functions.name: xsltFlagRVTs
functions.signature: int xsltFlagRVTs(xsltTransformContextPtr ctxt, xmlXPathObjectPtr obj, int val)
functions.description: Mark/flag Result Value Trees referenced by an XPath object to a given state/value (e.g., persistence). Internal helper for lifecycle management. Returns status int.
requirements: ctxt must be valid.
obj must be a valid xmlXPathObjectPtr possibly containing RVT references.
val is an integer flag; accepted range/values are not specified here.

functions.name: xsltFreeRVTs
functions.description: Free all RVTs held by the transformation context according to their registration categories. Internal cleanup.
requirements: ctxt must be valid.
After this call, previously created RVTs associated with ctxt should not be used.

functions.name: xsltReleaseRVT
functions.description: Release a specific RVT xmlDoc from the transformation context, freeing it as appropriate. Internal cleanup helper.
requirements: ctxt must be valid.
RVT must be an RVT xmlDoc previously registered with ctxt.
Do not access RVT after release.

functions.name: xsltCompileAttr
functions.description: Compile an attribute value template (AVT) or related attribute within a stylesheet node and attach compiled form for faster evaluation at run-time. Internal compiler helper.
requirements: style must be a valid stylesheet.
attr must be a valid xmlAttrPtr belonging to a stylesheet document.
The compiled representation is internal; evaluate with xsltEvalAVT and free with xsltFreeAVTList when appropriate.

functions.name: xsltEvalAVT
functions.signature: xmlChar * xsltEvalAVT(xsltTransformContextPtr ctxt, void *avt, xmlNodePtr node)
functions.description: Evaluate a precompiled Attribute Value Template (AVT) in the given context and node, returning a newly-allocated string value. Internal evaluator.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid transformation context.
avt must be a pointer to a compiled AVT object produced by xsltCompileAttr (opaque here).
node must be the current node for evaluation.
Returned xmlChar* must be freed by the caller using the libxml2 deallocator (exact function not specified here).

functions.name: xsltFreeAVTList
functions.description: Free a compiled AVT list/object previously created by xsltCompileAttr. Internal deallocator.
requirements: avt must be a pointer to a compiled AVT object obtained from libxslt.
Behavior on NULL is unspecified.

functions.name: xsltUninit
functions.description: Finalize/tear down libxslt’s internal global state after xsltCleanupGlobals/xsltInit sequences. Internal helper for clean shutdown.
requirements: Should be called only as part of a correct libxslt global init/uninit sequence; exact ordering with other cleanup calls is not specified here.
Not thread-safe to call concurrently with active transformations.

functions.name: xsltParseSequenceConstructor
functions.description: Parse a sequence constructor (content) starting at node 'start' during stylesheet compilation, recording compiled items in the compiler context. Internal, refactored-only.
requirements: Available only when XSLT_REFACTORED is defined at build time.
cctxt must be a valid compiler context.
start must be a valid xmlNodePtr in a stylesheet.

functions.name: xsltParseAnyXSLTElem
functions.description: Parse any XSLT element node and compile it into internal representation via the compiler context. Returns int status (unspecified here). Internal, refactored-only.
requirements: Available only when XSLT_REFACTORED is defined at build time.
cctxt must be valid.
elem must be a valid xmlNodePtr pointing to an XSLT element.

functions.name: xsltRestoreDocumentNamespaces
functions.description: Restore document namespace declarations from an internal namespace map onto an xmlDoc. Internal helper for refactored namespace comparison mode.
requirements: Available only when XSLT_REFACTORED_XSLT_NSCOMP is defined at build time.
ns must be a valid xsltNsMapPtr chain/map.
doc must be a valid xmlDocPtr to modify.

functions.name: xsltInitCtxtKey
functions.signature: int xsltInitCtxtKey(xsltTransformContextPtr ctxt, xsltDocumentPtr doc, xsltKeyDefPtr keyd)
functions.description: Initialize/compute key values for a specific xsl:key definition 'keyd' within a document for the given transformation context. Returns int status. Internal key management.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid transformation context.
doc must be a valid xsltDocumentPtr associated with the context.
keyd must be a valid key definition.

functions.name: xsltInitAllDocKeys
functions.description: Initialize/compute all defined keys for all documents used by the transformation context. Returns int status. Internal key setup.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid transformation context with stylesheets and documents properly loaded.

functions.name: xsltParseStylesheetAttributeSet
functions.description: Parses an xsl:attribute-set element from the stylesheet and records it in the stylesheet’s internal data structures so it can be referenced via use-attribute-sets during transformation. Typical usage is during stylesheet compilation when iterating over children of an xsl:stylesheet; call this on nodes that are xsl:attribute-set elements. Errors are reported via libxslt’s error handling; the function does not return a status.
requirements: style must be a valid, initialized xsltStylesheetPtr for the stylesheet being compiled.
cur must be a non-null xmlNodePtr pointing to an element node representing an xsl:attribute-set declaration (normally in the XSLT namespace).
This function is intended to be called during stylesheet parsing/compilation, before any transformation begins.
The caller should rely on libxslt’s global/context error callbacks for diagnostics, since the function returns void.

functions.name: xsltFreeAttributeSetsHashes
functions.description: Releases the internal hash tables/data structures holding parsed attribute-set definitions for the given stylesheet. Typically used during stylesheet destruction/cleanup to avoid memory leaks.
requirements: style must be a valid xsltStylesheetPtr that owns any attribute-set data to be freed.
Do not use the stylesheet’s attribute-set-related data after calling this function; it invalidates those structures.
Call during or before stylesheet finalization; not during an active transformation using this stylesheet.
The function returns void; errors (if any) are reported via libxslt’s error mechanisms.

functions.name: xsltApplyAttributeSet
functions.signature: void xsltApplyAttributeSet(xsltTransformContextPtr ctxt, xmlNodePtr node, xmlNodePtr inst, const xmlChar *attributes)
functions.description: Applies one or more named attribute sets to the target result node within an active transformation. The attributes parameter specifies the attribute-set names (typically a whitespace-separated list of QNames from an xsl:use-attribute-sets). The inst node is the instruction node causing the application (used for context/error reporting). Any created attributes are attached to node according to XSLT rules; conflicts are resolved per XSLT precedence rules. Errors are reported via the transform context.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid, active xsltTransformContextPtr for the current transformation.
node must be a valid xmlNodePtr that can accept attributes (e.g., an element node in the result tree).

inst should be a valid xmlNodePtr corresponding to the calling instruction (e.g., the element with use-attribute-sets); may be used for error reporting and namespace resolution. If unknown, pass a relevant instruction node; behavior with NULL is library-defined/unknown.
attributes must be a non-null pointer to a string containing one or more attribute-set names, typically as whitespace-separated QNames; names must resolve in scope according to XSLT namespace rules.
Should be called after the stylesheet’s attribute sets have been parsed and resolved (i.e., during transformation, not during compilation).
The function returns void; the caller must handle any emitted errors/warnings via ctxt’s error callbacks.
Do not pass a node from a different document/context that cannot legally receive attributes (doing so may cause errors).

functions.name: xsltResolveStylesheetAttributeSet
functions.description: Resolves references among attribute sets declared in the stylesheet (e.g., use-attribute-sets within attribute-set definitions), establishing final, ready-to-use attribute-set structures and detecting cycles or unresolved references. Intended to run after all attribute-set declarations have been parsed and before transformation begins.
requirements: style must be a valid, fully parsed xsltStylesheetPtr containing any attribute-set declarations to resolve.
Call after parsing all xsl:attribute-set elements and before starting transformations that use them.
Cyclic or invalid references are reported via libxslt’s error reporting; the function returns void and provides no direct status.
The stylesheet should remain mutable during resolution; do not modify/use attribute sets concurrently from other threads while this runs (thread-safety depends on overall libxslt usage).

functions.name: xsltNewDocument
functions.description: Creates and registers a document handle within the given XSLT transformation context for an already-parsed libxml2 document. Typically used to make an xmlDoc available to the transformation and participate in the document cache so the same document is not loaded multiple times.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid, initialized xsltTransformContextPtr (not NULL).
doc must be a valid xmlDocPtr (not NULL) obtained from libxml2 parsing APIs.
The returned xsltDocumentPtr is managed by the transformation engine; callers should not free the underlying document via this handle unless library documentation explicitly allows it.
Do not use the returned handle after the transformation context has been cleaned up or xsltFreeDocuments has been called.

functions.name: xsltLoadDocument
functions.description: Loads a document by URI at transformation time, registers it with the transformation context, and returns the associated xsltDocument handle (cached so repeated loads of the same URI resolve to the same document).
requirements: ctxt must be a valid, initialized xsltTransformContextPtr (not NULL).
URI must be a non-NULL, null-terminated xmlChar string designating the document location.
The returned document will be managed (and later freed) by the transformation engine; callers must not free it directly.
Errors are indicated by a NULL return; callers should check for NULL before use.

functions.name: xsltFindDocument
functions.description: Finds and returns the xsltDocument handle associated with a given libxml2 xmlDoc within the transformation context’s document set. Useful to query the cache rather than loading or creating a new entry.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid, initialized xsltTransformContextPtr (not NULL).
doc must be a valid xmlDocPtr (not NULL).
If the document is not registered in the context, the function may return NULL; callers must check for NULL.

functions.name: xsltFreeDocuments
functions.description: Frees all documents associated with a given transformation context and clears the internal cache maintained for document(). Call during transformation teardown/cleanup.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid xsltTransformContextPtr (not NULL).
After this call, any xsltDocumentPtr or xmlDocPtr references owned by the context must not be used.
Must be called only when no further access to the context’s documents is needed.

functions.name: xsltLoadStyleDocument
functions.description: Loads a stylesheet-related document by URI during stylesheet compilation (e.g., for xsl:include or xsl:import) and associates it with the stylesheet’s document set.
requirements: style must be a valid, initialized xsltStylesheetPtr (not NULL).
URI must be a non-NULL, null-terminated xmlChar string designating the document location.
On failure, returns NULL; callers must check the return value before use.
The returned document is managed by the stylesheet engine and will be freed later by xsltFreeStyleDocuments or stylesheet cleanup.

functions.name: xsltNewStyleDocument
functions.description: Registers an already-parsed libxml2 document with the stylesheet’s document set, making it available for includes/imports or other compile-time references.
requirements: style must be a valid, initialized xsltStylesheetPtr (not NULL).
doc must be a valid xmlDocPtr (not NULL) obtained from libxml2 parsing APIs.
Ownership of the registered document is managed by the stylesheet engine; do not free it directly once registered.
Do not use the returned handle after the stylesheet has been freed or xsltFreeStyleDocuments has been called.

functions.name: xsltFreeStyleDocuments
functions.description: Frees all documents associated with a stylesheet (e.g., those loaded for xsl:include/import) and clears the stylesheet’s document cache.
requirements: style must be a valid xsltStylesheetPtr (not NULL).
After this call, any xsltDocumentPtr or xmlDocPtr references owned by the stylesheet must not be used.
Should be called during stylesheet teardown when no further access to these documents is needed.

functions.name: xsltSetLoaderFunc
functions.description: Installs a custom document loader callback used by the engine to load documents for stylesheets and transformations (e.g., for xsl:include/import and document() calls). The loader function is called with a URI, parser dictionary, parser options, a context pointer, and a load type, and must return an xmlDocPtr or NULL on error. Per the header’s comment, the returned document may be modified and will be freed by the engine later.
requirements: f must be a function matching the xsltDocLoaderFunc signature: xmlDocPtr (*)(const xmlChar *URI, xmlDictPtr dict, int options, void *ctxt, xsltLoadType type).
The custom loader must return either a valid xmlDocPtr or NULL on error.
Per the header comment, any xmlDocPtr returned by the loader will be modified and freed by the engine; the loader and caller must not free it.

The loader must tolerate being called for multiple load types (XSLT_LOAD_START, XSLT_LOAD_STYLESHEET, XSLT_LOAD_DOCUMENT) and should interpret the opaque ctxt accordingly (stylesheet or transformation context).
Error signaling from the loader must be via returning NULL; exceptions are not part of the C API contract.

functions.name: xsltInitGlobals
functions.description: Initialize global variables used by the XSLT extension system. Typically called once early in process startup before registering or using extensions.
requirements: Should be called before any other extension registration or use.
May be called exactly once per process initialization; reentrancy and idempotency are not documented.
Thread-safety is unknown; call during single-threaded initialization.

functions.name: xsltRegisterExtModule
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN int XSLTCALL xsltRegisterExtModule(const xmlChar *URI, xsltExtInitFunction initFunc, xsltExtShutdownFunction shutdownFunc);
functions.description: Register an XSLT extension module identified by a namespace URI with transformation-time init and shutdown callbacks. Enables use of functions/elements provided by the module during transformations.
requirements: URI must be a valid, null-terminated xmlChar string identifying the extension namespace.
initFunc must be a valid function pointer or NULL if no init is needed (behavior if NULL is not documented).
shutdownFunc must be a valid function pointer or NULL if no shutdown is needed (behavior if NULL is not documented).
Must be called before looking up or using any extension functionality for the given URI.
Caller must check the returned int for success/failure (exact convention not specified here).

functions.name: xsltRegisterExtModuleFull
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN int XSLTCALL xsltRegisterExtModuleFull(const xmlChar *URI, xsltExtInitFunction initFunc, xsltExtShutdownFunction shutdownFunc, xsltStyleExtInitFunction styleInitFunc, xsltStyleExtShutdownFunction styleShutdownFunc);
functions.description: Register an XSLT extension module with both transformation-time and stylesheet-time init/shutdown callbacks. Allows per-stylesheet and per-transformation data to be managed by the module.
requirements: URI must be a valid, null-terminated xmlChar string.
initFunc/shutdownFunc handle per-transformation lifecycle; styleInitFunc/styleShutdownFunc handle per-stylesheet lifecycle; each function pointer may be NULL (behavior if NULL is not documented).
Must be called before using or looking up functionality for the given URI.
Caller must check the returned int for success/failure (convention not specified here).

functions.name: xsltUnregisterExtModule
functions.description: Unregister a previously registered extension module identified by its namespace URI.
requirements: URI must refer to a module previously registered.
Must not be called while active transformations are using the module (lifetime/synchronization not documented).
Caller must check the returned int for success/failure (convention not specified here).

functions.name: xsltGetExtData
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN void * XSLTCALL xsltGetExtData(xsltTransformContextPtr ctxt, const xmlChar *URI);
functions.description: Retrieve per-transformation module data for the extension identified by URI from the given transformation context. The data is created by the module’s init callback.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid xsltTransformContextPtr active during a transformation.
URI must correspond to a registered extension module.
May return NULL if the module is not registered, initialization failed, or no data is associated.

functions.name: xsltStyleGetExtData
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN void * XSLTCALL xsltStyleGetExtData(xsltStylesheetPtr style, const xmlChar *URI);
functions.description: Retrieve per-stylesheet module data for the extension identified by URI from the given stylesheet. The data is created by the module’s stylesheet init callback (if any).
requirements: style must be a valid xsltStylesheetPtr.
URI must correspond to a registered extension module (registered with stylesheet-level callbacks for data to exist).
May return NULL if not available.

functions.name: xsltStyleStylesheetLevelGetExtData
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN void * XSLTCALL xsltStyleStylesheetLevelGetExtData(xsltStylesheetPtr style, const xmlChar *URI);
functions.description: Retrieve module data specifically at the stylesheet level for the extension identified by URI. Available only when built with XSLT_REFACTORED.
requirements: style must be a valid xsltStylesheetPtr.
URI must correspond to a registered extension module.
Availability depends on build-time macro XSLT_REFACTORED; callers must conditionally compile or check headers accordingly.
May return NULL if not available.

functions.name: xsltShutdownCtxtExts
functions.description: Invoke shutdown for all extension modules associated with the given transformation context, releasing per-transformation resources.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid xsltTransformContextPtr.
Should be called when a transformation context is being finalized and no longer used.

functions.name: xsltShutdownExts
functions.description: Invoke shutdown for all stylesheet-level extensions associated with the given stylesheet, releasing per-stylesheet resources.
requirements: style must be a valid xsltStylesheetPtr.
Should be called during stylesheet cleanup when the stylesheet is no longer used.

functions.name: xsltXPathGetTransformContext
functions.description: Obtain the xsltTransformContextPtr associated with an XPath parser context, typically used inside extension XPath functions to access the current transformation state.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid xmlXPathParserContextPtr provided by libxml2 during XPath evaluation.
May return NULL if no associated transform context exists.

functions.name: xsltRegisterExtModuleFunction
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN int XSLTCALL xsltRegisterExtModuleFunction(const xmlChar *name, const xmlChar *URI, xmlXPathFunction function);
functions.description: Register an XPath extension function under a local name and namespace URI for use in XSLT expressions.
requirements: name must be a valid local name as a null-terminated xmlChar string.
URI must be the namespace URI identifying the extension module.
function must be a valid xmlXPathFunction callback.
Must be called before use/lookup of the function.
Caller must check the returned int for success/failure (convention not specified here).

functions.name: xsltExtModuleFunctionLookup
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN xmlXPathFunction XSLTCALL xsltExtModuleFunctionLookup(const xmlChar *name, const xmlChar *URI);
functions.description: Look up a previously registered XPath extension function by local name and namespace URI and return its callback pointer.
requirements: name and URI must match a function previously registered.
Returns NULL if not found.

functions.name: xsltUnregisterExtModuleFunction
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN int XSLTCALL xsltUnregisterExtModuleFunction(const xmlChar *name, const xmlChar *URI);
functions.description: Unregister a previously registered XPath extension function by local name and namespace URI.
requirements: name and URI must identify a previously registered function.
Should not be called while the function might be in use by active evaluations (synchronization not documented).
Caller must check the returned int for success/failure (convention not specified here).

functions.name: xsltNewElemPreComp
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN xsltElemPreCompPtr XSLTCALL xsltNewElemPreComp(xsltStylesheetPtr style, xmlNodePtr inst, xsltTransformFunction function);
functions.description: Create a new precompiled representation (precomp) for an extension element instruction node with an associated transform callback.
requirements: style must be a valid xsltStylesheetPtr.
inst must be a valid xmlNodePtr referring to the instruction element node.
function should be a valid xsltTransformFunction to execute for this element (NULL handling not documented).
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: xsltInitElemPreComp
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN void XSLTCALL xsltInitElemPreComp(xsltElemPreCompPtr comp, xsltStylesheetPtr style, xmlNodePtr inst, xsltTransformFunction function, xsltElemPreCompDeallocator freeFunc);
functions.description: Initialize an xsltElemPreComp structure for an extension element, setting its stylesheet, instruction node, execution callback, and deallocator.
requirements: comp must point to an allocated xsltElemPreComp structure.
style must be a valid xsltStylesheetPtr.
inst must be a valid xmlNodePtr for the instruction element.
function should be a valid xsltTransformFunction (NULL handling not documented).
freeFunc should be a valid deallocator for the precomp object (NULL handling not documented).

functions.name: xsltRegisterExtModuleElement
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN int XSLTCALL xsltRegisterExtModuleElement(const xmlChar *name, const xmlChar *URI, xsltPreComputeFunction precomp, xsltTransformFunction transform);
functions.description: Register an extension element by local name and namespace URI with optional precompute and transform callbacks.
requirements: name must be a valid local name as a null-terminated xmlChar string.
URI must be the namespace URI identifying the extension module.
precomp may be NULL or a valid xsltPreComputeFunction (behavior if NULL not documented).
transform must be a valid xsltTransformFunction to execute for the element.
Must be called before using or looking up the element.
Caller must check the returned int for success/failure (convention not specified here).

functions.name: xsltExtElementLookup
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN xsltTransformFunction XSLTCALL xsltExtElementLookup(xsltTransformContextPtr ctxt, const xmlChar *name, const xmlChar *URI);
functions.description: Look up the transform callback for an extension element by local name and namespace URI within a given transformation context.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid xsltTransformContextPtr.
name and URI must refer to a registered extension element.
Returns NULL if not found.

functions.name: xsltExtModuleElementLookup
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN xsltTransformFunction XSLTCALL xsltExtModuleElementLookup(const xmlChar *name, const xmlChar *URI);
functions.description: Look up a registered extension element’s transform callback by local name and namespace URI (context-independent).
requirements: name and URI must refer to a previously registered extension element.
Returns NULL if not found.

functions.name: xsltExtModuleElementPreComputeLookup
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN xsltPreComputeFunction XSLTCALL xsltExtModuleElementPreComputeLookup(const xmlChar *name, const xmlChar *URI);
functions.description: Look up a registered extension element’s precompute callback by local name and namespace URI.
requirements: name and URI must refer to a previously registered extension element with a precompute callback.
Returns NULL if not found.

functions.name: xsltUnregisterExtModuleElement
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN int XSLTCALL xsltUnregisterExtModuleElement(const xmlChar *name, const xmlChar *URI);
functions.description: Unregister a previously registered extension element by local name and namespace URI.
requirements: name and URI must identify a previously registered extension element.
Should not be called while the element might be in use by active transformations (synchronization not documented).
Caller must check the returned int for success/failure (convention not specified here).

functions.name: xsltRegisterExtModuleTopLevel
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN int XSLTCALL xsltRegisterExtModuleTopLevel(const xmlChar *name, const xmlChar *URI, xsltTopLevelFunction function);
functions.description: Register a top-level element handler for a given local name and namespace URI to be invoked at stylesheet processing time.
requirements: name must be a valid local name as a null-terminated xmlChar string.
URI must be the namespace URI identifying the extension module.
function must be a valid xsltTopLevelFunction callback.
Must be called before stylesheet compilation/processing that uses the element.
Caller must check the returned int for success/failure (convention not specified here).

functions.name: xsltExtModuleTopLevelLookup
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN xsltTopLevelFunction XSLTCALL xsltExtModuleTopLevelLookup(const xmlChar *name, const xmlChar *URI);
functions.description: Look up a previously registered top-level element handler by local name and namespace URI.
requirements: name and URI must match a registered top-level handler.
Returns NULL if not found.

functions.name: xsltUnregisterExtModuleTopLevel
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN int XSLTCALL xsltUnregisterExtModuleTopLevel(const xmlChar *name, const xmlChar *URI);
functions.description: Unregister a previously registered top-level element handler by local name and namespace URI.
requirements: name and URI must identify a previously registered top-level handler.
Should not be called while stylesheets that use the handler are being processed (synchronization not documented).
Caller must check the returned int for success/failure (convention not specified here).

functions.name: xsltRegisterExtFunction
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN int XSLTCALL xsltRegisterExtFunction(xsltTransformContextPtr ctxt, const xmlChar *name, const xmlChar *URI, xmlXPathFunction function);
functions.description: Deprecated: Register an XPath extension function into a specific transformation context. Prefer module-level registration via xsltRegisterExtModuleFunction.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid xsltTransformContextPtr.
name must be a valid local name.
URI must be the namespace URI identifying the extension.
function must be a valid xmlXPathFunction callback.
Caller must check the returned int for success/failure (convention not specified here).

functions.name: xsltRegisterExtElement
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN int XSLTCALL xsltRegisterExtElement(xsltTransformContextPtr ctxt, const xmlChar *name, const xmlChar *URI, xsltTransformFunction function);
functions.description: Deprecated: Register an extension element transform callback into a specific transformation context. Prefer module-level registration via xsltRegisterExtModuleElement.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid xsltTransformContextPtr.
name must be a valid local name.
URI must be the namespace URI identifying the extension.
function must be a valid xsltTransformFunction callback.
Caller must check the returned int for success/failure (convention not specified here).

functions.name: xsltRegisterExtPrefix
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN int XSLTCALL xsltRegisterExtPrefix(xsltStylesheetPtr style, const xmlChar *prefix, const xmlChar *URI);
functions.description: Associate an extension namespace prefix with a namespace URI in a stylesheet, used by the processor during preprocessing.
requirements: style must be a valid xsltStylesheetPtr.
prefix must be a null-terminated xmlChar string (may be empty for default namespace; not specified).
URI must be a valid namespace URI as a null-terminated xmlChar string.
Caller must check the returned int for success/failure (convention not specified here).

functions.name: xsltCheckExtPrefix
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN int XSLTCALL xsltCheckExtPrefix(xsltStylesheetPtr style, const xmlChar *URI);
functions.description: Check whether the given namespace URI is declared/recognized as an extension namespace in the stylesheet.
requirements: style must be a valid xsltStylesheetPtr.
URI must be a valid namespace URI string.
Return value semantics (boolean/convention) are not specified; caller must interpret per library docs.

functions.name: xsltCheckExtURI
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN int XSLTCALL xsltCheckExtURI(xsltStylesheetPtr style, const xmlChar *URI);
functions.description: Check whether the given namespace URI is allowed/recognized for extension use in the stylesheet.
requirements: style must be a valid xsltStylesheetPtr.
URI must be a valid namespace URI string.
Return value semantics are not specified; caller must check and interpret per library docs.

functions.name: xsltInitCtxtExts
functions.description: Initialize all extension modules for a transformation context, preparing per-context data as needed.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid xsltTransformContextPtr.
Must be called before using extensions in the given transformation context if not already initialized.
Caller must check the returned int for success/failure (convention not specified here).

functions.name: xsltFreeCtxtExts
functions.description: Free resources associated with extensions in the given transformation context.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid xsltTransformContextPtr.
Should be called when the transformation context is being destroyed.

functions.name: xsltFreeExts
functions.description: Free extension-related resources associated with the given stylesheet.
requirements: style must be a valid xsltStylesheetPtr.
Should be called during stylesheet destruction/cleanup.

functions.name: xsltPreComputeExtModuleElement
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN xsltElemPreCompPtr XSLTCALL xsltPreComputeExtModuleElement(xsltStylesheetPtr style, xmlNodePtr inst);
functions.description: Precompute and return the xsltElemPreComp for an extension element instruction node within a stylesheet.
requirements: style must be a valid xsltStylesheetPtr.
inst must be a valid xmlNodePtr referring to the instruction element.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: xsltGetExtInfo
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN xmlHashTablePtr XSLTCALL xsltGetExtInfo(xsltStylesheetPtr style, const xmlChar *URI);
functions.description: Return internal extension information (as an xmlHashTablePtr) for the given stylesheet and extension URI. Typically used by extension initialization such as EXSLT.
requirements: style must be a valid xsltStylesheetPtr.
URI must be a valid namespace URI string.
May return NULL if no info exists.

functions.name: xsltRegisterTestModule
functions.description: Register a built-in test extension module intended for testing the extension module API.
requirements: Should be called before using the test module’s features.
Intended for testing; not for production use.

functions.name: xsltDebugDumpExtensions
functions.description: Dump information about registered extensions to the given FILE stream for debugging purposes.
requirements: output must be a valid FILE* open for writing.
Caller is responsible for thread-safety around the FILE stream and concurrent extension modifications (not documented).

functions.name: xsltFunctionNodeSet
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN void XSLTCALL xsltFunctionNodeSet(xmlXPathParserContextPtr ctxt, int nargs);
functions.description: Implements the libxslt node-set() XPath extension function, converting an RTF (result tree fragment) or similar value to a node-set within the XPath evaluation. Intended to be invoked by the libxml2 XPath engine as a registered extension function; it consumes arguments from the XPath evaluation stack and pushes the result back onto the stack. Exact semantics and edge cases are not documented in this header; behavior is inferred from the function name and common libxslt usage patterns.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid, initialized xmlXPathParserContextPtr provided by the libxml2 XPath engine.
nargs must match the number of arguments for the function present on the XPath evaluation stack; typically node-set() expects exactly 1 argument (inferred from common usage).
The XPath stack must contain at least nargs items; the function will consume nargs items and push a result (inferred from libxml2 XPath extension callback conventions).
Thread-safety and reentrancy follow the constraints of the provided XPath context; no additional guarantees are stated in this header (unknown specifics).

functions.name: xsltDebug
functions.signature: XSLTPUBFUN void XSLTCALL xsltDebug(xsltTransformContextPtr ctxt, xmlNodePtr node, xmlNodePtr inst, xsltElemPreCompPtr comp);
functions.description: Handles a libxslt-specific debug extension element or hook during a transformation. Typically used to assist debugging by inspecting the current node, instruction element, and any precompiled element data. Exact output, side effects, and invocation conditions are not documented in this header and are inferred from the function name and parameter types.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid, initialized xsltTransformContextPtr for the ongoing transformation.
node should be the current source node being processed (inferred).
inst should reference the instruction (stylesheet) node triggering the debug action (inferred).
comp, if provided, should be the precompiled representation of the instruction; may be NULL depending on caller behavior (inferred).
No return value; any diagnostic or side effects are internal to the transformation/debug facilities (exact behavior unknown).

functions.name: xsltRegisterExtras
functions.description: Registers libxslt-specific extension functions/elements (outside EXSLT) for a given transformation context, enabling use of these extensions within that context. Typical usage is during transformation setup before stylesheet execution.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid, initialized xsltTransformContextPtr.
Should be called before starting the transformation or before any stylesheet instructions that rely on these extensions are executed (inferred).
Effects are limited to the provided context; it does not perform global registration (inferred).

functions.name: xsltRegisterAllExtras
functions.description: Registers all libxslt-specific extensions globally so they become available to transformations by default. Useful for initializing extension availability across contexts. Exact registration scope and thread-safety guarantees are not documented in this header.
requirements: Should be called during initialization before creating transformation contexts or running transformations that rely on these extensions (inferred).
No parameters and no return value; errors or duplicate registrations, if any, are handled internally (unknown specifics).
Thread-safety of concurrent calls is not documented; callers should avoid racy initialization in multithreaded setups unless library documentation guarantees safety (unknown).

functions.name: xsltXPathFunctionLookup
functions.signature: xmlXPathFunction xsltXPathFunctionLookup(void *vctxt, const xmlChar *name, const xmlChar *ns_uri);
functions.description: Lookup callback that resolves an XPath/XSLT function name (optionally namespace-qualified) to an implementation function (xmlXPathFunction). Intended to be registered on an xmlXPathContext via the XSLT_REGISTER_FUNCTION_LOOKUP macro so that XSLT-defined extension functions are found during expression evaluation. Typically used internally by libxslt but can be installed by callers preparing a custom XPath context for XSLT evaluation.
requirements: vctxt should be the user data associated with the XPath context’s function lookup (as installed by XSLT_REGISTER_FUNCTION_LOOKUP); commonly an XSLT/transform context.
name must be a non-NULL, null-terminated xmlChar UTF-8 string naming the function local name.
ns_uri may be NULL (no namespace) or a null-terminated xmlChar UTF-8 namespace URI string.
Returns NULL if the function is not found; callers must handle a NULL result by treating the function as undefined.

functions.name: xsltDocumentFunction
functions.description: Implements the XSLT document() function. Evaluates the function using the XPath parser context stack and pushes the result (a node-set) back to the stack. Arity is 1 or 2 per XSLT 1.0. This is called by the XPath engine during function evaluation; it does not return a value directly.
requirements: ctxt must be a valid, non-NULL xmlXPathParserContextPtr belonging to an XPath evaluation in an XSLT transform.
nargs must be 1 or 2; other values are an error.

Argument 1 is typically a string (URI) or a node-set convertible to a string; Argument 2 (optional) is a node-set providing the base node-set for resolving relative URIs, per XSLT 1.0 semantics. (Inferred from XSLT specification).
On success, the function pushes a node-set result onto the XPath value stack; callers must not expect a C return value.

import os
import random
import string

# We generate a valid XSLT stylesheet file content. The fuzz stubs use:
# - FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME(): they will create a file with our returned bytes.
# - xsltParseStylesheetFile expects a filename to an XSLT stylesheet.
# - xsltParseStylesheetImport/Include build a stylesheet containing xsl:import/include href set to FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME().
#   Therefore, returning a filename-like string is fine; the harness will map it to a file containing our bytes.
#
# Our generator returns bytes of an XSLT document that exercises various features:
# - Top-level xsl:output (tests xsltParseStylesheetOutput)
# - xsl:decimal-format (tests decimal format lookup/format-number)
# - xsl:key and use via key() (exercises key compilation/lookup)
# - xsl:attribute-set and use-attribute-sets (xsltParseStylesheetAttributeSet, xsltApplyAttributeSet)
# - A named template and call-template
# - apply-templates with mode, for-each, sort
# - AVTs, variables/params, number/format-number
# - Namespace alias declaration
#
# The content is seeded-random to vary names/values while remaining valid.

XML_HEADER = "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n"
XSL_NS = "http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform"

def _rand_ident(rng, prefix="id", min_len=4, max_len=10):
    n = rng.randint(min_len, max_len)
    letters = string.ascii_letters
    return f"{prefix}{''.join(rng.choice(letters) for _ in range(n))}"

def _rand_qname(rng, prefix):
    local = _rand_ident(rng, "n")
    return f"{prefix}:{local}"

def _rand_text(rng, min_len=3, max_len=12):
    n = rng.randint(min_len, max_len)
    chars = string.ascii_letters + "     1234567890"
    s = ''.join(rng.choice(chars) for _ in range(n))
    # ensure not all whitespace
    if s.strip() == "":
        s = "text"
    return s

def _gen_stylesheet(rng):
    # Random prefixes for extension/alias examples
    pref_xsl = "xsl"  # keep standard
    pref_ext = rng.choice(["ex", "m", "u"])  # extension namespace prefix
    ext_uri = f"urn:example:{_rand_ident(rng,'ext')[:6]}"

    # Random names
    attrset_name = _rand_qname(rng, "as")
    key_name = _rand_ident(rng, "k")
    key_match = rng.choice(["//item", "//node()", "//entry", "//book", "//@*"])
    key_use = rng.choice(["@id", "string(.)", "@name", "concat(@type,'-',@id)"])
    decfmt_name = _rand_ident(rng, "df")
    named_templ = _rand_ident(rng, "tmpl")
    mode_name = _rand_ident(rng, "m")

    # Random formatting pattern and some numbers
    fmt_pattern = rng.choice(["#,##0.###", "0.00", "###,###", "00000" ])

    # Random AVT pieces
    avt_attr_val = _rand_text(rng)

    # Build stylesheet
    parts = []
    parts.append(XML_HEADER)
    parts.append(f"<stylesheet xmlns=\"{XSL_NS}\" xmlns:{pref_ext}=\"{ext_uri}\" version=\"1.0\" exclude-result-prefixes=\"{pref_ext}\">")

    # Output settings
    parts.append("  <output method=\"xml\" encoding=\"UTF-8\" indent=\"yes\"/>")

    # Namespace alias (no-op but valid)
    parts.append("  <namespace-alias stylesheet-prefix=\"#default\" result-prefix=\"#default\"/>")

    # Decimal format
    parts.append(f"  <decimal-format name=\"{decfmt_name}\" decimal-separator=\".\" grouping-separator=\",\"/>")

    # Attribute set
    parts.append(f"  <attribute-set name=\"{attrset_name}\">")
    parts.append("    <attribute name=\"class\" select=\"'generated'\"/>")
    parts.append("    <attribute name=\"data-avt\">{position()}</attribute>")
    parts.append("  </attribute-set>")

    # Key definition
    parts.append(f"  <key name=\"{key_name}\" match=\"{key_match}\" use=\"{key_use}\"/>")

    # Top-level variable/param
    parts.append("  <param name=\"pTop\" select=\"'P'\"/>")
    parts.append("  <variable name=\"vTop\" select=\"'V'\"/>")

    # Named template
    parts.append(f"  <template name=\"{named_templ}\">")
    parts.append("    <text>Named:</text>")
    parts.append("    <value-of select=\"$pTop\"/>")
    parts.append("    <text>-</text>")
    parts.append("    <value-of select=\"$vTop\"/>")
    parts.append("  </template>")

    # Root template
    parts.append("  <template match=\"/\">")
    parts.append("    <element name=\"result\" use-attribute-sets=\"" + attrset_name + "\">")
    parts.append("      <text>root </text>")
    parts.append(f"      <call-template name=\"{named_templ}\"/>")
    parts.append("      <text> count=</text>")
    parts.append("      <number/>")
    parts.append("      <text> fmt=</text>")
    parts.append(f"      <value-of select=\"format-number(12345.6789, '{fmt_pattern}', '{decfmt_name}')\"/>")
    parts.append("      <text> key=</text>")
    # Lookup key by first available candidate
    parts.append(f"      <value-of select=\"count(key('{key_name}', //@*|//node()))\"/>")
    parts.append("      <text> </text>")
    parts.append("      <apply-templates select=\"//*\" mode=\"" + mode_name + "\">")
    parts.append("        <sort select=\"name()\" data-type=\"text\"/>")
    parts.append("      </apply-templates>")
    parts.append("    </element>")
    parts.append("  </template>")

    # Mode template with AVT usage and attribute creation
    parts.append(f"  <template match=\"*\" mode=\"{mode_name}\">")
    parts.append("    <element name=\"item\" use-attribute-sets=\"" + attrset_name + "\">")
    parts.append("      <attribute name=\"name\" select=\"name()\"/>")
    parts.append("      <attribute name=\"rand\">" + avt_attr_val + "</attribute>")
    parts.append("      <copy-of select=\"@*\"/>")
    parts.append("      <value-of select=\"string(.)\"/>")
    parts.append("    </element>")
    parts.append("  </template>")

    parts.append("</stylesheet>")
    xml = "\n".join(parts)
    return xml.encode("utf-8")


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # With some probability, vary structure slightly for breadth
    xml_bytes = _gen_stylesheet(rng)

def make_ncname(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    first_choices = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_"
    rest_choices = first_choices + "0123456789.-_"
    n = rng.randint(1, 10)
    s = rng.choice(first_choices)
    s += "".join(rng.choice(rest_choices) for _ in range(n - 1))
    return s

# Build a single null-terminated UTF-8 string

def nz(s: str) -> bytes:
    return s.encode('utf-8', 'strict') + b"\x00"

# Compose a diverse sequence of strings to satisfy different stubs in one buffer

def build_strings(rng: random.Random):
    out = []

    # Whitespace-focused for xsltIsBlank
    out.extend(WHITESPACE_STRINGS)
    out.append("\t  \n\r ")

    # Names, URIs, prefixes
    out.extend(NS_URIS)
    out.extend(URIS)
    out.extend(PREFIXES)

    # Local names and QNames
    out.extend(LOCAL_NAMES)
    for _ in range(5):
        pfx = rng.choice(PREFIXES)
        ln = rng.choice(LOCAL_NAMES)
        out.append(f"{pfx}:{ln}")

    # Patterns and XPath
    out.extend(PATTERNS)
    out.extend(XPATHS)

    # AVTs and decimal patterns
    out.extend(AVTS)
    out.extend(DECIMAL_PATTERNS)

    # Template/mode names
    out.extend(TEMPLATE_NAMES)

    # Attribute names
    out.extend(ATTR_NAMES)

    # Some numbers as strings and random integers
    for v in ["0", "1", "-1", "42", "123456", "3.14159", "-273.15"]:
        out.append(v)

    # Unicode samples
    out.extend(UNICODE_SAMPLES)

    # Random synthesized pieces to increase variety
    for _ in range(20):
        choice = rng.randint(0, 6)
        if choice == 0:
            out.append(make_ncname(rng))
        elif choice == 1:
            # Random QName
            out.append(f"{make_ncname(rng)}:{make_ncname(rng)}")
        elif choice == 2:
            # Random URI-ish
            out.append(f"urn:{make_ncname(rng)}:{rng.randint(0,9999)}")
        elif choice == 3:
            # Simple AVT-like
            out.append(f"{{{rng.randint(0, 9)}+{rng.randint(0, 9)}}}")
        elif choice == 4:
            # Pattern-like
            out.append("//" + make_ncname(rng))
        elif choice == 5:
            # Attribute with value template-ish content
            out.append(f"{make_ncname(rng)}")
        else:
            # Decimal pattern-like
            out.append(rng.choice(DECIMAL_PATTERNS))

    # Ensure non-empty strings list
    out = [s if isinstance(s, str) else str(s) for s in out if s is not None]

    # Cap overly long ones to keep total small
    capped = []
    for s in out:
        if len(s) > 256:
            s = s[:256]
        capped.append(s)

    return capped


def assemble_buffer(strings, rng: random.Random, budget=4096) -> bytes:
    # Shuffle to avoid strong ordering effects
    rng.shuffle(strings)

    buf = bytearray()

    # Include a small header of random bytes occasionally (consumed by integer FUZZ_PARAMs)
    for _ in range(8):
        buf += struct.pack('<I', rng.getrandbits(32))

    for s in strings:
        b = nz(s)
        if len(buf) + len(b) > budget:
            break
        buf += b

    # Ensure at least one trailing NUL for consumers expecting a string even if everything trimmed
    if not buf or buf[-1] != 0:
        if len(buf) + 1 <= budget:
            buf += b"\x00"
    return bytes(buf)


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    strings = build_strings(rng)
    return assemble_buffer(strings, rng)

# Target data type: namespace URI (null-terminated UTF-8 string). Many stubs also use
# local names and QNames, and sometimes pass NULL instead. Our buffer should contain
# several NUL-terminated strings that look like realistic namespace URIs and names,
# along with a small amount of control data for choices.
#
# Strategy:
# - Emit a sequence of C strings (each NUL-terminated) to satisfy repeated FUZZ_PARAM_STR
#   consumption across stubs. Keep under 4096 bytes total.
# - Include a mix of:
#   * Common namespace URIs (XSLT, EXSLT, XML, XHTML, XLink)
#   * Random http/urn/data URIs
#   * Empty string entries ("\0") for some calls that accept NULL; harness may still pass
#     pointer to empty string which is benign.
#   * Local names suitable for functions/elements/keys (ASCII letters, digits, dashes, underscores)
# - Append a few 32-bit integers to serve as FUZZ_PARAM(unsigned int) values used in selection paths.
# - Ensure all strings are valid UTF-8 and reasonably short to avoid pathological parser paths.
#
# The buffer layout:
# [ count (1 byte) ]
# Then that many NUL-terminated UTF-8 strings, concatenated.
# Then K 32-bit little-endian integers as control values.
#
# The harness will read FUZZ_PARAM_STR sequentially from the buffer; providing many
# strings improves coverage across calls like register/unregister/lookups.

_MAX_BYTES = 4096

_COMMON_URIS = [
    "http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform",
    "http://exslt.org/common",
    "http://exslt.org/math",
    "http://exslt.org/sets",
    "http://exslt.org/strings",
    "http://exslt.org/dates-and-times",
    "http://xml.apache.org/xalan",
    "http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace",
    "http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml",
    "http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink",
]

_COMMON_LOCAL_NAMES = [
    "format-number", "node-set", "document", "generate-id", "system-property",
    "element-available", "function-available", "key", "sort", "if", "for-each",
    "apply-templates", "call-template", "value-of", "copy-of", "text", "element",
    "attribute", "comment", "processing-instruction", "number",
]

def _rand_uri(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    choice = rng.randint(0, 5)
    if choice == 0:
        return rng.choice(_COMMON_URIS)
    elif choice == 1:
        # http(s) URI
        host = ''.join(rng.choice(string.ascii_lowercase) for _ in range(rng.randint(3, 8)))
        tld = rng.choice(["com", "org", "net", "io", "dev"])
        path_segs = [
            ''.join(rng.choice(string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits + "-_") for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 6)))
            for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 3))
        ]
        scheme = rng.choice(["http", "https"]) 
        uri = f"{scheme}://{host}.{tld}"
        if path_segs:
            uri += "/" + "/".join(path_segs)
        return uri
    elif choice == 2:
        # urn
        nid = rng.choice(["uuid", "example", "xmlns"]) 
        nss = ''.join(rng.choice(string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits + "-._") for _ in range(rng.randint(4, 12)))
        return f"urn:{nid}:{nss}"
    elif choice == 3:
        # data URI (short)
        payload = ''.join(rng.choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits) for _ in range(rng.randint(4, 12)))
        return f"data:text/plain,{payload}"
    elif choice == 4:
        # empty to simulate optional/NULL-like usage
        return ""
    else:
        # Known EXSLT namespaces
        return rng.choice([
            "http://exslt.org/common",
            "http://exslt.org/math",
            "http://exslt.org/sets",
            "http://exslt.org/strings",
            "http://exslt.org/dates-and-times",
        ])

def _rand_local_name(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    if rng.random() < 0.4:
        return rng.choice(_COMMON_LOCAL_NAMES)
    first = rng.choice(string.ascii_letters + "_:")
    rest_len = rng.randint(0, 15)
    rest_chars = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "-_.:"
    rest = ''.join(rng.choice(rest_chars) for _ in range(rest_len))
    # Avoid all-colon which may be odd; ensure at least one non-colon
    if all(c == ':' for c in (first + rest)):
        rest = "name"
    return first + rest

def _pack_u32_le(x: int) -> bytes:
    return bytes((x & 0xFF, (x >> 8) & 0xFF, (x >> 16) & 0xFF, (x >> 24) & 0xFF))

def _build_strings(rng: random.Random, budget: int) -> List[bytes]:
    strings: List[bytes] = []
    # Aim for 30-60 strings, but stop before exceeding budget
    target = rng.randint(30, 60)
    for i in range(target):
        # Alternate between URIs and names
        if i % 3 == 0:
            s = _rand_uri(rng)
        elif i % 3 == 1:
            s = _rand_local_name(rng)
        else:
            # QName-like: prefix:local
            prefix = ''.join(rng.choice(string.ascii_lowercase) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 5)))
            local = _rand_local_name(rng).replace(':', '')
            s = f"{prefix}:{local}" if rng.random() < 0.8 else local
        # Truncate to reasonable size to keep overall under limit
        if len(s) > 128:
            s = s[:128]
        b = s.encode('utf-8') + b"\x00"
        if sum(len(x) for x in strings) + len(b) > budget:
            break
        strings.append(b)
    return strings

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # Reserve some space for control integers at the end
    max_total = _MAX_BYTES
    control_bytes = 4 * 16  # 16 integers
    header_bytes = 1
    budget = max_total - control_bytes - header_bytes

    strs = _build_strings(rng, budget)
    # Ensure we have at least some entries; if none, add a couple of defaults
    if not strs:
        strs = [b"http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform\x00", b"format-number\x00", b"\x00"]

    # Build control ints with varied bit patterns used by stubs (e.g., &1 decisions)
    controls = []
    patterns = [0, 1, 2, 3, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xAAAAAAAA, 0x55555555, 0x80000000]
    for i in range(16):
        if i < len(patterns):
            val = patterns[i]
        else:
            val = rng.getrandbits(32)
        controls.append(val)

    # Assemble buffer
    out = bytearray()
    count = min(255, len(strs))  # 1-byte count cap
    out.append(count)
    total_len = 1
    for i in range(count):
        s = strs[i]
        out.extend(s)
        total_len += len(s)
    for v in controls:
        out.extend(_pack_u32_le(v))
        total_len += 4
    # Ensure size constraint
    if len(out) > _MAX_BYTES:
        out = out[:_MAX_BYTES]
    return bytes(out)

#  9) permille

# format patterns covering groups, decimals, percent/permille, negative patterns,
# prefixes/suffixes, and different zero/digit placeholders.

_SUFFIX_PREFIX_VARIANTS = [
    "'items:' #,##0",
    "#,##0 'kg'",
    "'+'0;'-'0",
    "'val='0.###",
]


def _choose_decimal_preset(r: random.Random):
    return r.choice(_DECIMAL_FORMAT_PRESETS)


def _build_pattern(r: random.Random, df: dict) -> str:
    pat = r.choice(_BASE_PATTERNS + _SUFFIX_PREFIX_VARIANTS)
    # Optionally inject percent/permille explicitly based on symbols
    inject = r.randint(0, 3)
    if inject == 1:
        pat += df.get("percent", "%")
    elif inject == 2:
        pat += df.get("permille", "‰")
    # Occasionally produce two-pattern positive;negative form using separator
    if r.random() < 0.3:
        sep = df.get("patternSeparator", ";") or ";"
        neg = pat
        # Simple negative variant with minus in prefix
        neg = df.get("minusSign", "-") + neg
        pat = pat + sep + neg
    return pat


def _encode_cstr_list(strings: List[str]) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()
    for s in strings:
        b = s.encode('utf-8') + b"\x00"
        out.extend(b)
        if len(out) > _MAX_TOTAL:
            break
    return bytes(out)


def _bounded_pack(buf: bytearray, more: bytes):
    remain = _MAX_TOTAL - len(buf)
    if remain <= 0:
        return
    buf.extend(more[:remain])


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    r = random.Random(seed)
    df = _choose_decimal_preset(r)

    # Possibly tweak some symbols to explore odd cases while staying valid
    def maybe(s: str, alt: str) -> str:

    digit = df["digit"]
    patternSeparator = df["patternSeparator"]
    minusSign = maybe(df["minusSign"], df["minusSign"] + df["minusSign"])  # double sign

    noNumber = df["noNumber"]
    decimalPoint = df["decimalPoint"]
    grouping = df["grouping"]
    percent = df["percent"]
    permille = df["permille"]
    zeroDigit = df["zeroDigit"]

        patternSeparator,
        minusSign,
        infinity,
        noNumber,
        decimalPoint,
        grouping,
        percent,
        permille,
        zeroDigit,
        pattern,
    ]

    buf = bytearray()
    _bounded_pack(buf, _encode_cstr_list(cstrs))

    # Unsigned long: generate interesting magnitudes
    ul_choices = [0, 1, 2, 9, 10, 99, 100, 999, 1000, 123456, 2**31-1, 2**32-1, 2**48, 2**63-1]

    ul_val = r.choice(ul_choices)

        ul_val = (ul_val + r.getrandbits(16)) & ((1 << 64) - 1)

    # Pack as little-endian 64-bit to cover typical FUZZ_PARAM(unsigned long) implementations
    _bounded_pack(buf, struct.pack('<Q', ul_val))

    return bytes(buf)

        parts.append(open_tag)
        # recursion
        parts.append(_gen_children(rng, depth - 1, {**nsmap, **local_nsmap}))
        parts.append(close_tag)

    # possibly an empty element
    if rng.random() < 0.3:
        name = _rand_choice(rng, CHILD_ELEMENT_NAMES)
        local_nsmap = {}
        if ":" in name:
            prefix = name.split(":", 1)[0]
            if f"xmlns:{prefix}" not in nsmap:
                local_nsmap[f"xmlns:{prefix}"] = f"urn:{prefix}"
        attrs = _gen_attrs(rng, local_nsmap)
        empty_tag = f"<{name}"
        if attrs:
            empty_tag += " " + attrs
        empty_tag += "/>"
        parts.append(empty_tag)

    return "".join(parts)


def _gen_internal_subset(rng: random.Random) -> Tuple[str, List[str]]:
    # Build a small internal DTD subset with a couple of entities and element decls
    ents = ENTITY_DECLS.copy()
    rng.shuffle(ents)
    ents = ents[: rng.randint(0, len(ents))]
    entity_lines = [f"<!ENTITY {n} '{v}'>" for (n, v) in ents]

    el_lines = []
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        el_lines.append("<!ELEMENT root ANY>")
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        el_lines.append("<!ATTLIST root id ID #IMPLIED>")

    subset = "\n".join(entity_lines + el_lines)
    refs = [f"&{n};" for (n, _) in ents]
    return subset, refs


def _assemble_doc(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    decl = _rand_choice(rng, XML_DECLS)

    # Optional PI before root
    pi = ""
    if rng.random() < 0.6:
        pi = f"<?{_rand_choice(rng, PI_TARGETS)} {_rand_choice(rng, PI_DATA)}?>"

    # Choose root name and namespaces
    root_name = _rand_choice(rng, ROOT_NAMES)
    nsmap_choice = _rand_choice(rng, NS_DECL_SETS) if rng.random() < 0.9 else {}
    nsmap = dict(nsmap_choice)

    # Internal subset (DTD)
    subset, refs = _gen_internal_subset(rng)
    dtd = ""
    if subset:
        dtd = f"<!DOCTYPE {root_name.split(':')[-1]} [\n{subset}\n]>"

    # Root attributes (may add namespace decls inside)
    attrs = _gen_attrs(rng, nsmap)

    # Combine children: include some entity refs from DTD
    children = _gen_children(rng, rng.randint(1, 3), nsmap)
    if refs and rng.random() < 0.7:
        # inject a couple of entity references safely into text
        k = min(len(refs), rng.randint(1, 2))
        injection = " ".join(rng.sample(refs, k=k))
        children = injection + children

    open_tag = f"<{root_name}"
    if attrs:
        open_tag += " " + attrs
    open_tag += ">"
    close_tag = f"</{root_name}>"

    parts = [decl]
    if pi:
        parts.append(pi)
    if dtd:
        parts.append(dtd)
    parts.append(open_tag)
    parts.append(children)
    parts.append(close_tag)

    xml = "\n".join([p for p in parts if p])

    # Ensure size under 2048 (stub truncates) but keep well-formedness
    if len(xml) > 2000:
        # Keep opening and closing root intact and reduce inner content
        head = "\n".join([p for p in [decl, pi, dtd] if p]) + ("\n" if (decl or pi or dtd) else "") + open_tag
        tail = close_tag
        inner = children
        max_inner = max(0, 1800 - len(head) - len(tail))
        inner = inner[:max_inner]
        xml = head + inner + tail

    return xml


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    # Create multiple candidates and pick one within limits
    best = None
    for _ in range(4):
        doc = _assemble_doc(rng)
        if len(doc.encode('utf-8')) <= 2048:
            best = doc
            break
        best = doc  # fallback to last built; will be truncated by harness anyway

    data = (best or _assemble_doc(rng)).encode('utf-8')
    if len(data) > 4096:
        data = data[:4096]
    return data
